title: Connect simplicial numbers to face numbers of simplicial complexes

problemStatement.plain: Can the simplicial numbers be connected to the face numbers of simplicial complexes (f-vectors) in algebraic topology?

currentState.focus: Formalize connection between simplicial numbers and f-vectors of standard simplices

insights: faceCount k j = C(k+1, j+1) = simplicial (j+1) (k-j): the index shift is j+1 not j
